column1: # Türkiye, Diyanet: namazvakitleri.diyanet.gov.tr district (ilçe) tables, 396 days each
# (25 Sep 2026 – 31 Dec 2027, the page's month and its 2027 year), restricted: archive only.
# Its first column is İmsak, which is both the Fajr start and the end of eating (F+E).
# - The 22 analysed districts, each at its unit's point (Diyanet's own published point for İstanbul,
#   Ankara, Tekirdağ, Adana, Hatay and Karaman; the app's for the other sixteen). Fit on the research's
#   five (İstanbul, Ankara, Tekirdağ, Edirne, Van); the other seventeen held out. Nine of them were the
#   edge's own held-out rows (Diyanet's method at the user's point, a minute later for starts and earlier
#   for sunrise) until the round of 12 November 2026 made them units at the same points (ruling R140):
#   Antalya, Bursa, Diyarbakır, Gaziantep, İzmir and Konya (their merkez tables) and İstanbul's own
#   Çatalca, Şile and Silivri, whose tables are Diyanet's for those ilçe. The edge is the fitted method with
#   +60 s on starts and −60 s on sunrise, never looser (R143); its own held-out rows are R171's below.
# - other.turkey (the old picker's method: Diyanet's algorithm at any point, plain safe rounding) at
#   Diyanet's six published points, held out: never fitted.
# - The weekly monitor's capture of 28 Sep 2026 of the same 22 district pages (29 Sep – 29 Oct 2026 and
#   all of 2027, 396 days each; the same minutes as the research's on every day both hold), each at its
#   research row's unit, and at Diyanet's six points for other.turkey, held out: it adds 26–29
#   October 2026. Its rows read the copy pinned as it was then (archive/tables/pinned/tr-diyanet/2026-09-28/),
#   since the monitor's own files grow with each fetch.
# - The monitor's capture of 2 Oct 2026 (pinned, archive/tables/pinned/tr-diyanet/2026-10-02/): the same 22
#   pages, now 29 Sep – 1 Nov 2026 and all of 2027 (the same minutes as the 28 Sep capture on every day both
#   hold), at the same units and other.turkey points, held out: it adds 30 October – 1 November 2026.
# - The review of 12 November 2026 (ruling R171): fifteen districts Diyanet prints a table for beside eight of the
#   nine units of R140 (archive/code/manual/tr-diyanet/districts.py, one plain GET each on 12 Nov 2026, all of 2026),
#   each checked as the app resolves the place: inside its unit's reach, 10 and 14.5 km from the unit's point toward
#   the district's own, where the district's point rides beside; at its own point and 3 km east of it, where most are
#   on the edge (the edge's own held-out rows) and Kestel, Selçuklu, Meram, Karatay and Aksu are inside a unit's
#   reach. Rows at a point fitted from its own table (no app city there) are fit rows. And the nine units' own
#   captures of 9 Nov 2026 at the edge, 18 km from each unit's point, the offset the edge is meant to absorb.
# - The round of 12–13 November 2026 (ruling R200): the 62 il centres that had no unit, each read from Diyanet's own
#   district page by one plain GET on 12 Nov 2026 (archive/code/manual/tr-diyanet/all_districts.py), all of 2026 (365
#   days: since 9 Nov 2026 the page prints calendar 2026 alone, so these units stand on 2026 until Diyanet prints 2027
#   again), each at its unit's point (the app's point for the city), held out: none was in the fit. Their rows are
# - Ruling R201 (13 November 2026), the block between its markers at the end of this section, written by
#   archive/code/manual/tr-diyanet/beside.py (it rewrites that block alone; the limits it reads are measured by
#   limits.py beside it): R171's check for every unit, İstanbul and Ankara among them. Every district that is no unit
#   and whose point lies within a unit's reach and 15 km more rides beside that unit, and is checked on its own 2026
#   table as the app resolves the place: inside the unit's reach 10 and 14.5 km from the unit's point toward its own
#   (and half a kilometre inside İstanbul's and Ankara's longer reach), at its own point and 3 km east of it. A
#   district's point is not one Diyanet publishes: it is the point at which the fitted method best matches the
#   district's own table (rounded to 0.01°, westward in longitude), so rows of such a district are fit rows; when
#   Diyanet prints 2027 again they can be held out. And each of the 62 units of R200 at the edge, 18 km from its point
#   and beyond every reach (test rows, R143).
# - Ruling R204 (13 November 2026, the review's fix; rows in the same block, their notes say "R204"). R201's disc
#   around a district's point stops 2 km short of the unit's point on every side, so it left the district's far side
#   and flanks on the unit's table alone, and the rows on the line between the two points could not see it. A
#   district now also rides wherever the place is within 15 km of its point, or of its own town where that is known
#   and lies more than 2 km from the fitted point, and nearer to that than to the unit's point; a district that
#   shares the unit's town by name (Yeşilyurt and Malatya, their points 8.7 km apart) rides across it. The rows: for every pair,
#   places just past half way toward the district, 5 km beyond its point, and 6 and 12 km to either side of it,
#   wherever the unit holds them; the unit's own point, 1 km and 1.9 km from it for a shared town; each riding
#   district's own town where the app's city list (or, for Atakum, the municipality's stated place, not fetched)
#   gives it, and 3 km beyond a town that anchors. beside.py stops if a place the rule should cover is not covered.
#   A place nearer the unit's point than the district's point and town, outside the district's disc, still follows
#   the unit's table alone: the rule is of points and distances, and no district boundary is held.
# - Ruling R203 (13 November 2026): six units stand at Diyanet's computing point, not at the app's own point for the
#   city (İstanbul's is 2 km west of it, Ankara's 2 km south). Within 2 km of the app's point no neighbouring district
#   rides, as within 2 km of the unit's (R171): the city's own town follows the city's table alone. Their rows, each at
#   the app's point on the monitor's files as pinned on 11 Nov 2026, stand before R201's block.
# - What the files called "of 9 Nov 2026" and "pinned 2026-11-11" below hold. The monitor's file for a district grows
#   with each fetch and keeps the days a later page no longer prints. Diyanet's page printed all of 2027 until the
#   fetch of 31 Oct 2026; the page fetched on 9 Nov 2026 prints calendar 2026 alone. So those files, headed "fetched
#   2026-11-09", hold 2026 as the page printed it on 9 Nov and 2027 as it was last printed on 31 Oct: two fetches in
#   one file, and the 2027 half is not on Diyanet's page now. Every 2027 day in this group rests on that earlier
#   printing until Diyanet prints 2027 again and it is read anew.
